statement: A staged platform candidate is compiled for the shadow comparison only: what an instance enforces compiles with the limits and attributes of the platform document it installed, so staging a change, or withdrawing it, neither fails an enforced document closed nor brings one back. Only a published platform document changes them.
guards: runtime:PlatformCompilerCandidateTest#a staged platform candidate leaves the enforced documents as they were
runtime:PlatformCompilerCandidateTest#publishing the same change does reach them
spring-boot:ShadowReportingWiringTest#a staged platform candidate leaves what the instance compiles with as it was
